turns.prompt: Look at the attached mobile viewport screenshot of our user profile card and the component file src/components/ProfileCard.vue. The long name 'Alexander Montgomery-Clarington' is causing the container to overflow, clipping the follow button, and overlapping the subtitle text. Fix the template/styles inside ProfileCard.vue to ensure proper layout, wrapping, and spacing without breaking desktop viewports.

turns.diagnosis: The issue is caused by a rigid structural constraint in the parent container. Specifically, the card template uses a hardcoded height class 'h-48' combined with 'flex' but missing responsive layout shifting (e.g., stacking on mobile, side-by-side on desktop). Because the text container has 'overflow-hidden', the text wraps but gets clipped visually, overlapping the elements underneath it.
turns.fix_proposed: We will switch the container from a fixed 'h-48' layout to an adaptive layout using Scoped CSS / standard classes. On mobile viewports, the elements will stack vertically with an auto-height configuration ('flex flex-col h-auto'), and gracefully transform into a row layout on larger displays ('md:flex-row'). We will also add text wrapping parameters.
